OVERVIEW

Completely redesigns the HUD to resemble a [Weakaura HUD from WoW](https://i.imgur.com/LdOWUXZ.png),
solely to make it easier to track ability cooldowns. Most of your eyeball bandwidth during gameplay
is used up around the center of your monitor. Placing HUD elements near the center of your screen
compensates for this and allows you to check your CDs while also watching gameplay simultaneously.

Also Includes a few QoL changes like hiding QWER labels, squaring some text alignments,
fixing pixels gaps made by Riot, and removing useless buttons from the hud.
I do have a mod that is more complete in removing all distractions & nonsense called
[Adblock for LoL.](https://runeforge.dev/mods/6c349b3c-8683-47e4-b70a-45f5cb2f7b74)

This is pixel perfect ONLY on 0 [ZERØ] HUD scale (on 1440 lmao). Adjust your HUD scale ±1 if
things look off, or u can tell me if you notice a 1 pixel error that I messed up.

**I greatly appreciate any bug reports & improvement ideas (even if i dont like it).**
